dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: One of my colleagues came across some newly formed Condessence Crystals and Magical Crystal Ore on the way over here. Good thing, he was on the ball too, or he would've tripped over them.

dialogues.speaker: Michica
dialogues.text: Ores are very important resources, you know... They can be used to make lots of different things. If you have some spare time to go mine some, I'm sure they'd come in handy. They're not far off — I'll show you where to look.
